turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on word order (subject + verb + object)?
turns.tutor:
Look: paints / Lina / pictures / at home becomes Lina paints pictures at home. I put the subject first, then the verb, then the object, then the place.
Rule: say the subject first, then the verb, then the object; place or time goes last.
Right: Omar kicks the ball in the park. Wrong: Kicks Omar the ball in the park.
Now you try. Put in order: "plays / Sam / chess / on Mondays"
